config.displayTip: The FUSE reticle in the game HUD, and its preview in the manager. In interactive mode the preview plays a scripted cannon.
config.languageTip: Language for Crosshair. Automatic follows the FUSE App.
config.showManagerTip: Shows the crosshair manager. Its close button and the shortcut also change this.
config.managerKeyTip: Shows or hides the crosshair manager.
config.inGameTip: Draws the reticle in the game HUD in place of the game's default aim. Off shows the game's aim again.
config.reticleTip: The reticle in the game and in the preview. Each reticle has its own settings.
config.reloadTip: The ghost and the aimed sound, and when they play.
config.ghostTip: The moment the ghost and the aimed sound play.
config.ghostDispersionTip: When the dispersion goes back to its smallest size.
config.sidesTip: Reload progress on the three sides of the reticle.
config.clockwiseTip: The sides fill one after another, clockwise from the top.
config.middleOutTip: All three sides fill at the same time, from their middle out to the corners.
config.barsTip: Reload progress on the bars left and right of the reticle. Off hides the bars.
config.colorTip: The sides and the ghost. The track under the sides takes this colour at half its opacity.
config.reloadColorTip: The sides while the gun reloads.
config.centerColorTip: The small triangle on the gun point.
config.centerStrokeColorTip: The 1 px outline around the center mark.
config.barColorTip: The reload fill of the side bars.
config.barWorkColorTip: The track under the reload fill of the side bars, at its full length.
config.barBaseColorTip: The base under the reload fill of the side bars.
config.aimedSoundTip: Plays a sound with the ghost: when the dispersion settles, or when the reload ends.
config.rangeTip: The colour of the range marks, from the game's range data at the aim point.
config.effectiveTip: The shot keeps its full effect at this distance.
config.falloffTip: The shot loses effect with distance.
config.outTip: Too far for its full effect, too close for a missile to arm, or a machine gun past its effective range.

scene.aliveTip: While you drive, aim or use an ability.
scene.mapTip: While the tactical map is open.
scene.deadTip: From the fatal hit until the deploy screen.
scene.deployTip: On the deploy screen and during the spawn drop.

reticle.triangleTip: Three sides that follow the dispersion. The sides and the side bars show the reload. The marks show the range.
reticle.bracketsTip: Four corner brackets that follow the dispersion. The brackets and the side bars show the reload. The marks beside the center dot show the range.
reticle.ringTip: A ring of three arcs that follows the dispersion. The arcs and the side bars show the reload. The marks between the arcs show the range.

ring.sidesTip: Reload progress on the three arcs.
ring.clockwiseTip: The arcs fill one after another, clockwise from the top.
ring.middleOutTip: All three arcs fill at the same time, from their middle out to both ends.
ring.reloadColorTip: The arcs while the gun reloads.
ring.baseColorTip: The full ring under the arcs.
ring.rimColorTip: The thin line on the outer edge of the ring.
ring.backdropColorTip: The circle behind the center dot.

brackets.sidesTip: Reload progress on the four corner brackets.
brackets.clockwiseTip: The brackets fill one after another, clockwise from the top left.
brackets.middleOutTip: All four brackets fill at the same time, from their corner out to both ends.
brackets.colorTip: The brackets and the ghost. The track under the brackets takes this colour at half its opacity.
brackets.reloadColorTip: The brackets while the gun reloads.
brackets.centerColorTip: The dot on the gun point.
brackets.backdropColorTip: The square behind the center dot.
